title: Practice 8: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The wind is coming from the northeast.
exercises.why: **дуть → дует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Practice always pays off.
exercises.why: **окупаться → окупается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Which airline are you flying with?
exercises.why: **лететь → летишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why do you hang out with Tom?
exercises.why: **зависать → зависаешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom records video walkthroughs of games.
exercises.why: **записывать → записывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Книга ___ (сопровождаться) множеством хвалебных аннотаций от издателей.
exercises.prompt: The book's blurbs overflow with superlatives.
exercises.why: **сопровождаться → сопровождается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The other children call him Fatty.
exercises.why: **называть → называют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He keeps a small poultry yard.
exercises.why: **содержать → содержит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I use the "Firefox" browser.
exercises.why: **пользоваться → пользуюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The growth of the world economy is slowing down.
exercises.why: **замедляться → замедляется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I have lunch at noon.
exercises.why: **обедать → обедаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Poke the fire. It's going out.
exercises.why: **гаснуть → гаснет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I prefer this version.
exercises.why: **предпочитать → предпочитаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I want to get up and dance.
exercises.why: **хотеться → Хочется** — present tense,  person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Do Germans eat a lot of pork?
exercises.why: **есть → едят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Почему ты не ___ (подстраивать) свой образ жизни под обстоятельства?
exercises.prompt: Why don't you adapt your way of life to circumstances?
exercises.why: **подстраивать → подстраиваешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is as busy as a bee.
exercises.why: **трудиться → трудится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Grandmother mows the grass in the garden.
exercises.why: **косить → косит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Who are you texting?
exercises.why: **строчить → строчишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The movie has such a stupid ending.
exercises.why: **заканчиваться → заканчивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
